_readme: Average energy prices for COMMERCIAL / non-household customers, for outdoor-heater running-cost calculators. Gathered 30 Oct 2026 from the official sources named on each value (Eurostat API, DESNZ table_341.xlsx, Hydro-Québec 2025 comparison PDF, Statistics Canada WDS API table 25-10-0086, ESC Victoria VDO page, MBIE data via Figure.NZ, NRCan fuel prices, ECB reference rates). Every figure was read on the page/file at the url given; derived values show their arithmetic in 'derivation'. Prices are in local currency per kWh delivered (gas: per kWh of gas energy, gross calorific value where the source says so). Business basis = excluding VAT/GST (recoverable) unless 'basis' says otherwise. 'alt' holds other size bands from the same source. A null value carries a 'note' and, where useful, a 'proxy' that is NOT the requested measure. All verified:false until a human checks the source. Not found: AU gas, all LPG cylinder/bulk commercial figures. Blocked from here: ACCC (403), AER (connection refused), MBIE and data.govt.nz (bot check) - not circumvented.

fx.source: European Central Bank, euro foreign exchange reference rates (daily XML). USD->X derived as (EUR->X) / (EUR->USD); EUR = 1 / 1.1172. ECB quotes seen: USD 1.1172, GBP 0.83380, AUD 1.5904, CAD 1.5606, NZD 1.9823 per EUR.

kwh.period: rates in effect 1 Apr 2025 (2025 edition; latest edition linked by Hydro-Québec as of Oct 2026)
kwh.basis: excluding taxes; small-power customer, 10,000 kWh/month, 40 kW demand; unweighted mean of the 12 Canadian cities' average prices (range 9.69 Winnipeg to 20.99 Edmonton c/kWh)
kwh.source: Hydro-Québec, Comparison of Electricity Prices in Major North American Cities 2025, Detailed tables - Average prices on April 1, 2025 (excluding taxes)

gas_kwh.basis: Canada, commercial consumption: sales value (C$) / energy (GJ). Tax basis not stated by StatCan. DOUBTFUL: likely understates the delivered price, as the dollar series may cover only utility-supplied gas and not commodity bought from marketers; C$6.56/GJ looks low against utility commercial tariffs. Treat as a floor.
gas_kwh.source: Statistics Canada, Table 25-10-0086-01 Natural gas supply and disposition, monthly (Commercial consumption: cubic metres, gigajoules, Canadian dollars)

lpg_kg.note: No official commercial propane price per kg found.

lpg_l.note: No official commercial cylinder/bulk heating-propane price found. NRCan publishes only AUTO propane (vehicle fuel at the pump), which is not the same product price.

proxy.what: Auto propane, Canada average retail pump price, week of 2026-10-20 (128.9 c/L; later rows 129.1 c/L); tax basis not stated on page

kwh.basis: VICTORIA ONLY: Victorian Default Offer small-business flat tariff, usage charge only (excludes daily supply charge), mean of 5 distribution zones, GST removed. A regulated default price; market offers are often lower. Not a national average.
kwh.derivation: mean of 0.3423 (AusNet), 0.2477 (CitiPower), 0.2878 (Jemena), 0.2736 (Powercor), 0.2561 (United Energy) = A$0.2815/kWh incl GST; / 1.1 = A$0.256 ex GST
kwh.source: Essential Services Commission (Victoria), Victorian Default Offer 2026-27, small business flat tariffs

gas_kwh.note: None found. ACCC (gas inquiry, NEM inquiry) returned HTTP 403 and AER was unreachable from here; no other official small-business gas price per GJ/MJ was seen. The ACCC June 2026 NEM report (Q3 2025 small-business effective prices, c/kWh) should be checked by hand for electricity too: https://www.accc.gov.au/system/files/inquiry-national-electricity-market-report-june-2026.pdf

lpg_kg.note: None found. ACCC/FuelWatch monitor AUTOMOTIVE LPG only, which is not cylinder or bulk heating LPG.

kwh.period: calendar year 2024 (latest in MBIE Energy prices, June 2025 release, published 11 Sep 2025)
kwh.basis: commercial, nominal, excluding GST; sales-based average (sales value / kWh)
kwh.source: MBIE, Energy in New Zealand: Energy prices (June 2025), via Figure.NZ chart 'Nominal average prices of commercial and industrial electricity in New Zealand'

gas_kwh.period: calendar year 2024 (MBIE Energy prices, June 2025 release)
gas_kwh.derivation: about 10.09 NZ c/kWh as read from the chart by the fetch tool - check the exact figure
gas_kwh.source: MBIE, Energy in New Zealand: Energy prices (June 2025), via Figure.NZ chart 'Nominal average prices of natural gas in New Zealand'

lpg_kg.note: None found. Stats NZ publishes only a commercial LPG price INDEX (Q2 2025: -0.9% y/y), not a price: https://figure.nz/chart/MpufQ9UN7X2pUSFS-mRUs9AzxuoFYjUJx. MBIE's own site was behind a bot check.

kwh.basis: non-domestic, 'Small' band (20-499 MWh/yr), including Climate Change Levy, excluding VAT
kwh.source: DESNZ, Quarterly Energy Prices, Table 3.4.2 Prices of fuels purchased by non-domestic consumers (including CCL)

gas_kwh.basis: non-domestic, 'Small' band (278-2,777 MWh/yr, comparable to Eurostat band I2), including CCL, excluding VAT
gas_kwh.source: DESNZ, Quarterly Energy Prices, Table 3.4.2 (including CCL)

lpg_kg.note: None found. No official non-domestic LPG price; Sutherland Tables are paywalled.

lpg_l.note: No official commercial LPG price. Proxy below is DOMESTIC, one county, and stale.

proxy.what: Nottingham Energy Partnership, average Nottinghamshire LPG price, 55 p/litre (9.01 p/kWh at 90% boiler efficiency, 6.78 kWh/L), last priced Feb 2026 (unchanged since Apr 2025; no data Mar-Oct 2026); domestic, VAT basis not stated

kwh.basis: non-household band IB (20-499 MWh/yr), excluding VAT and other recoverable taxes and levies (Eurostat tax=X_VAT)
kwh.source: Eurostat, nrg_pc_205 Electricity prices for non-household consumers - bi-annual data (updated 19 Oct 2026)

gas_kwh.basis: non-household band I2 (1,000-9,999 GJ/yr), excluding VAT and other recoverable taxes and levies; per kWh GCV (Eurostat also gives EUR 31.8439/GJ GCV)
gas_kwh.source: Eurostat, nrg_pc_203 Gas prices for non-household consumers - bi-annual data

lpg_kg.note: None found: no official commercial propane price for the Netherlands was located.

lpg_l.note: None found (CBS publishes autogas pump prices only, which is not cylinder/bulk propane; not used).

kwh.basis: non-household band IB (20-499 MWh/yr), excluding VAT and other recoverable taxes and levies
kwh.source: Eurostat, nrg_pc_205 Electricity prices for non-household consumers - bi-annual data

gas_kwh.basis: non-household band I2 (1,000-9,999 GJ/yr), excluding VAT and other recoverable taxes and levies; per kWh GCV (EUR 22.5406/GJ GCV)
gas_kwh.source: Eurostat, nrg_pc_203 Gas prices for non-household consumers - bi-annual data

lpg_kg.note: None found. Destatis publishes Flüssiggas only as a price index; DVFG publishes no current average. Comparison portals (e.g. Check24, ~98 c/L incl VAT, May 2026, domestic tanks) are not authoritative and were not used.
